about: Lighthouses: positions from OpenStreetMap (man_made=lighthouse, ruins left out, disused but standing kept), heights from Wikidata (CC0) where recorded, then the OSM height tag, then 10 m for named or Wikidata-linked lights; unnamed lights with no height, lights under 6 m and anything Wikidata records as demolished are left out; features within 30 m merged. Observatories: positions OpenStreetMap; enclosure height and diameter approximate. [lat, lon, height m] and [lat, lon, height m, diameter m, D dome | T tower, name]. Landmarks (P, v3): hand profiles for structures the maps carry without their height or shape, as [name, heights above sea level (1) or the ground (0), parts]; each part [top m, bottom m, taper, roof shape, roof height m, footprint lat,lon,...]. Bridges from the decks, cables and arches in published dimensions on the OpenStreetMap positions of their towers; the Opera House shells are approximate. Each landmark carries the OpenStreetMap features it stands on (P entry, fourth item); all were checked against them on 21 October 2026.

P.checked: 0-1 m (span ends on the tower centres)

P.note: shells placed on the mapped harbour-end shells; heights and spacing from published figures
